notes.title: Voiceover Issues Resolved
notes.notes:
Localization error fixed that caused the English voiceover not to work.

* After changing the language settings, you must restart the game for the changes to take effect.

notes.title: Offline mode: Lone Mechanic
notes.notes:
We are excited to introduce the new offline mode: 'Lone Mechanic'. Now, you can play solo, repairing malfunctioning systems and exploring the ship, all without the need for an internet connection. Perfect for learning and enjoying the stunning views of space!
